verdict_prediction.why: the entropy floor should fix diversity (T1 distinct >> 7, H ~2 after u150), and T1 batch corr should still pass 0.3. But found also needs a frozen top-5 corr > 0.7, and the top 5 are ranked by conc K10 TRAIN net, not corr. In B5_PC_P8's own history the corr>0.7 T1 formulas rank 10th/16th/19th/40th of 757 by logged reward, and the near relative ranks 69th of 1261 by gross in the RGP P8 log; a more diverse frozen pool will mostly put moderate-corr volume formulas (corr ~0.4-0.6) on top. 40% for found: with H held at 2 the u80/u236 kind (EMA/TS_RANK of log_quote_volume at 168-336, corr ~0.8) stays in the sampled mass and one may make the top 5

step3.question: how grammar-rejected samples enter the gradient
step3.answer: m2h_b5_grammar.check runs before scoring; a reject raises CandidateLocalInvalid, so the formula keeps REWARD_FLOOR and valid_mask False. select full: adv = zfam(rewards, valid, counts) = within-family z over the VALID formulas only (mean/sd exclude rejects; one valid formula -> z 0), clipped +-3; then adv[rejected] = -1.0. dense_update runs on all 128 rows: pg_loss = mean over 128 of adv*neglogp, so rejects ARE in the loss denominator and each pushes its own tokens down with weight 1; the entropy term also averages over all 128. The whole step is skipped if batch n_valid < 20
step3.consequence: early T1 (u15: 3 valid, 40 rejected) gets ~40 rows of -1 vs ~3 rows of z in [-3, 3] whose mean is 0: the T1 gradient is mostly 'move away from rejected shapes', which favours short legal formulas (order's hypothesis; consistent with the T1 collapse onto 2-3 token log_quote_volume formulas)
step3.this_round: reported only, not changed (one variable per round)
